summary: This RFC defines a YANG data model for configuring and managing a syslog process, the standard way systems record and forward log messages. Vendors that build syslog collectors can use it so that network management tools can configure logging in a consistent way across devices.

eli5.summary: Computers keep a diary of what happens to them. This gives a standard form for telling a computer how and where to write its diary, so every brand can be set up the same way.

questions: how to configure syslog with netconf
